About

Formulated with a Collagen-Elastin Complex to increase skin elasticity, and patented Thiamidol to reduce the appearance of dark spots. Specially designed to target both early and more advanced signs of ageing. This Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity Day Care SPF 30 Refill contains 90% less plastic compared to the standard Eucerin face care jar.
NART: 99543-09900-11

Read more about our product

Anti-ageing day cream for skin showing both premature and more advanced signs of ageing. Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity Day SPF 30 is an anti-ageing day cream that improves skin elasticity, plumps deep wrinkles and reduces the appearance of dark spots.

The unique formula delivers multiple anti-ageing benefits. The Collagen-Elastin Complex, a powerful combination of creatine and hyaluronic acid, revitalises collagen production and improves skin elasticity. Eucerin’s patented Thiamidol helps to reduce the appearance of dark spots. An innovative blend of both high and low molecular hyaluronic acid visibly plumps deep wrinkles.

For skin that feels smoother, looks more radiant and appears visibly younger.

The day cream also contains SPF 30 and UVA and UVB filters to help protect against UV-induced premature skin ageing and the deepening of wrinkles.

How to Use

Instructions: - Ensure all components are completely dry before inserting the refill - Remove the lid and insert the refill into the jar - Apply in the morning to a thoroughly cleansed face, neck and décolletage - Gently massage into the skin - Avoid contact with the eyes - Do not exceed four applications per day of all face products containing Thiamidol - For best results, use in combination with other products from the Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity range

Clinical Formula

Collagen Elastin Complex
The new Collagen-Elastin Complex, a powerful combination of Arctiin and Creatine, re-energizes collagen production and increases skin’s elasticity.
Learn More
Creatine

Creatine is a natural acid produced by the kidneys and liver and mostly stored in the muscle cells. It can also come from your diet. Creatine supports the storage and transport of energy in the human body: muscle cells store energy in the form of Creatine Phosphate and it is transported to tissue with high energy demands such as hair follicles.

Learn More
Hyaluronic acid

Hyaluronic Acid is formed by skin cells and is part of the connective tissue of the skin. One of its key functions is to retain moisture, and it has the ability to bind in between 1,000 and 10,000 times its own weight in water (i.e. one gram binds between one and ten liters). As we age, the skin's natural ability to produce Hyaluronic Acid depletes and wrinkles start to form and deepen.

Learn More
Thiamidol

Thiamidol is a patented ingredient, known to fight hyperpigmentation acting at its root cause. It works by inhibiting the human tyrosinase, the key enzyme in melanin production. Hyperpigmentation can be the result of different causes, e.g. sun-induced dark spots, post-blemish marks or age spots. Key benefits are:

Reduction of Hyperpigmentation: By effectively inhibiting tyrosinase, Thiamidol decreases melanin synthesis, leading to a visible reduction in dark spots and an even skin tone.

Works on all skin types: Thiamidol is dermatologically tested and suitable for all skin types, including dry, oily, combination, normal and sensitive skin. It works for skin of any ethnicity or age and thus is effective on all skin types and tones.

Fights post-blemish marks: Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation happens when skin is inflamed or injured, for example because of blemishes. The impacted area is left darkened and hyperpigmented despite having otherwise healed. Thiamidol addresses these areas resulting in an even skin tone.

FAQ

How do I know if Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity is the right anti-age range for me?

Our skin is as different as we are, so the answer to that question varies from person to person and depends on many factors both internal (such as our genetics) and external (such as the amount of sun our skin has been exposed to).

The Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity range has been specially formulated for skin that shows the three main signs of ageing: dark spots, a lack of elasticity, and sagginess. While our skin is as individual as we are, and skin ages differently depending on our genetics and lifestyle, these concerns are normally experienced by those with ageing skin. The products work together to boost collagen, improve skin’s elasticity, and reduce the appearance of dark spots. Skin looks visibly younger, smoother, and more radiant. 

If you are in any doubt please read our article on skin at different ages or consult a pharmacist or dermatologist.

What age should I start using Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity?

As a general rule, the first signs of ageing such as fine lines and wrinkles start to appear in our 30s and the Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler range targets these concerns. By our 40s and 50s, most of us are experiencing sagging skin and a loss of volume and facial contours and benefit from products such as those in the Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity range. 

Why does Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity Day SPF 30 contain UVA and UVB protection?

Facial skin is more exposed to the sun than skin on the body and is vulnerable to harmful UVA and UVB rays, which can cause photoageing (premature skin ageing caused by the sun). With SPF 30 and a UVA filter, Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler +Elasticity Day Care SPF30 helps to protect against photoageing and the deepening of wrinkles.

What product should I use for the delicate skin around my eyes?

We recommend Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity Eye Care. It helps to reduce dark spots, improve skin elasticity and visibly plump deep wrinkles for smoother, firmer-looking skin.

Is this a suitable day cream for skin that shows signs of ageing?

Yes. Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity Day SPF 30 is formulated with the needs of skin that shows signs of ageing by improving elasticity while boost collagen, and reduces dark spots, making your skin feel firm and look fresher and more radiant.
